description: This Java source file defines the MonkeyKeyEvent class, which represents key events used within the Android 'Monkey' testing tool. It provides constructors, accessors, and an injection method to simulate key presses and releases programmatically during automated testing.

classes.name: MonkeyKeyEvent
classes.description: Represents a key event in the Monkey testing framework, allowing creation, manipulation, and injection of simulated key presses and releases.

methods.name: MonkeyKeyEvent(int action, int keyCode)
methods.description: Constructor creating a key event with default parameters.

methods.name: MonkeyKeyEvent(long downTime, long eventTime, int action, int keyCode, int repeatCount, int metaState, int device, int scanCode)
methods.description: Constructor with detailed timestamp and key parameters.

methods.name: getKeyCode()
methods.description: Returns the key code associated with this event.

methods.name: getAction()
methods.description: Returns the action type of the key event (e.g., ACTION_DOWN, ACTION_UP).

methods.name: getDownTime()
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the key was pressed down.

methods.name: getEventTime()
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the event occurrence.

methods.name: setDownTime(long downTime)
methods.description: Sets the down time timestamp; throws exception if wrapped KeyEvent is present.

methods.name: setEventTime(long eventTime)
methods.description: Sets the event time timestamp; throws exception if wrapped KeyEvent is present.

methods.name: isThrottlable()
methods.description: Indicates if the event can be throttled based on its action type.

methods.name: injectEvent(IWindowManager iwm, IActivityManager iam, int verbose)
methods.description: Injects the key event into the system using Android input injection mechanisms.
